dish.title: Grilled Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Lemon Pearl Couscous
dish.description: Rosemary-garlic lamb loin chops grilled to a pink center and spooned with a bright mint, parsley, caper, and lemon salsa verde. Served with lemony pearl couscous studded with peas and grilled zucchini.

recipe_version.title: Grilled Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Lemon Pearl Couscous
recipe_version.description: Rosemary-garlic lamb loin chops grilled to a pink center and spooned with a bright mint, parsley, caper, and lemon salsa verde. Served with lemony pearl couscous studded with peas and grilled zucchini.

ingredients.name: lamb loin chops
ingredients.display_name: lamb loin chops, about 1 1/4 inches thick

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: 3 grated for the chops, 1 grated for the salsa verde

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp chops, 1/2 cup salsa verde, 1 tbsp couscous, 1 tbsp zucchini

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp chops, 1/4 tsp salsa, 1/2 tsp couscous, 1/4 tsp zucchini

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.note: zest and juice: 2 tbsp juice salsa verde, 2 tbsp juice couscous

steps.title: Season the chops and prep
steps.body: Rub the chops with the rosemary, 3 grated garlic cloves, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and the pepper. Zest and juice the lemons. Slice the zucchini into planks.

steps.title: Cook the couscous
steps.body: Toast the pearl couscous in 1 tbsp olive oil in a 3-quart saucepan over medium for 2 minutes. Add 2 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer over low until tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in the peas, cover off the heat 3 minutes, then add 2 tbsp lemon juice and the zest.

steps.title: Make the salsa verde
steps.body: While the couscous simmers, stir the mint, parsley, capers, the last grated garlic clove, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 cup olive oil, and 1/4 tsp salt (overlap stated).

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.body: Preheat the grill on high, lid closed, for 10 minutes, then clean and oil the grate. Toss the zucchini with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt.

steps.title: Grill
steps.body: Grill the chops until 135 F for medium-rare, about 4 minutes per side, and the zucchini beside them until marked and tender-crisp, about 3 minutes per side. Rest the chops 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the couscous onto plates with the zucchini, set two chops on top, and spoon the salsa verde over the chops.
